one_line: Enterprise CRM platform for sales, service, and marketing data.
auth_notes: Requires creating a 'Connected App' in Setup to get a Consumer Key/Secret before any OAuth2 flow can run.
credential_requirements: Free Developer Edition account (developer.salesforce.com/signup); avoid the plain Free Trial account, which sometimes can't enable API access.
buildability_reason: Free developer account, mature and broad REST API, standard OAuth2 flow with public docs.

one_line: CRM and marketing/sales/service platform with a broad public API.
auth_notes: Legacy hapikey API keys were sunset in 2022. Private App tokens are simplest for single-portal use; OAuth2 required only for apps installed across many portals or listed on the Marketplace.
credential_requirements: Most plans including free tiers support Private Apps; some older free/developer-portal accounts don't and may need a Starter upgrade.
buildability_reason: Broad REST API, self-serve Private App tokens available on free tier for single-portal use cases.

one_line: Sales-pipeline-focused CRM with a developer-friendly REST API.
auth_notes: Static x-api-token header for internal/personal use; OAuth2 is only required for apps distributed via the Pipedrive Marketplace.
credential_requirements: Free developer account available; API token generated directly from account settings, no approval step.
buildability_reason: Simple static API token, free developer account, resource-based REST API with clear docs.

one_line: Modern, data-model-flexible CRM with REST API and OAuth-based MCP.
auth_notes: Access tokens are scoped to a single workspace; OAuth2 is required specifically for publishing an integration or connecting the official MCP server.
credential_requirements: Unlike Salesforce/HubSpot, Attio requires manually requesting a developer workspace via live chat/email (granted within a couple of days), or using a free trial workspace as a sandbox.
buildability_reason: Official MCP server already exists with OAuth-based agent access; the only friction is the manual developer-workspace request, which is fast (couple of days) not a hard gate.
